note: Ask your library (#45): questions on the demo library (tests/eval/demo.sqlite3), and the reels an answer must be able to cite. Scored on retrieval, keyword-only, so it runs with no model: each expected reel must be among the ones the model is given. A question in another language than the reel needs the embedder ("needs": "vectors"), and is skipped without it.

questions.q: How long does the sourdough need to proof?
What goes in the crab dip?
Where was the ramen lunch set?
Which reel showed how to make transparent wood?
What did I save about Kyoto?
